hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, or Space Grotesk.
Always apply tight tracking (tracking-tight) to headings.
Hierarchy gap: H1 to H2 must not jump more than 2 Tailwind steps.
FORBIDDEN: Teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
Always tint neutral grays towards blue to feel alive.
Only use Primary blue for CTAs to limit overuse.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content (use backdrop-blur + rgba).

surfaces: Dashboards: Flat Solid backgrounds with subtle 1px border-slate-200, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift and shadow-md.
Headers/Nav: Solid background with a hard bottom border, OR Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40).
Medical Data Cards: Flat, cardless, rectangular, dense styles. Avoid heavy shadows to prevent visual refraction of data.

borders.radius: rounded-md (Subtle roundness max 8px for medical feel)

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md for medical UI. Primary buttons use bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700. Provide clear micro-interactions (transform active:scale-95).
components.inputs: Clean, rectangular inputs with 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 border-blue-600.
components.cards: For Patient Side: Clean cards with generous padding (p-6, p-8). For Dashboard Side: Cardless, dense rows (p-4), sharp edges.
components.chat: Guided conversational flow. Main chat surface with step panel. Use quick-reply chips. Clear distinction between user and AI bubbles. Use sonner for alerts.
components.status_badges: Color-coded pills (red/yellow/green) with redundant text labels for Triage/Clinical Filters.
components.camera_mask: A centered overlay on a video feed area using a semi-transparent border (e.g., border-[50px] border-black/50) to enforce privacy bounds.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
grids.patient_mode: The Tetris Grid (Mode A): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical layout for landing.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) for patient forms. Dense compact spacing (p-2, p-4) for dashboard tables.
layouts.navigation: Header MUST have visible nav links on desktop (no hamburger only).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense medical data and paragraphs. Center only heroes.

motion.transitions: NEVER use 'transition: all'. Use specific properties: 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease'.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px must be 4.5:1 ratio against background. Hover states must explicitly set text color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='blind-request-submit-button').

media.icons: lucide-react for default. Phosphor Icons for dense dashboard (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).

image_urls.category: Placeholder for AI Chat Camera / Medication ID

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx for files, NOT .tsx (unless the repo is already strictly TS, but rule implies .js).
instructions_to_main_agent.component_libraries: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Use 'sonner' for toasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.ux_flow: 1. Patient Chat (Text/Camera) -> 2. Medication ID -> 3. Login/Register -> 4. Submit Blind Request. 5. Pharmacy Dashboard views queue -> 6. Clarify/Reject (AI Refinement) OR Accept (Fee + Contact Exchange).
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_rules: Top KPI strip, role-based views, Unified data panels, simple visual style. NO TEAL. Include 'Coming Soon' Concierge button.
instructions_to_main_agent.chat_rules: Guided stepwise flow. Main chat surface with right sidebar/step panel for intake progress. Use quick-reply chips.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_rule: MUST add data-testid to every button, input, and interactive element.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Build layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim over content.
Never center align the App container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI emoji characters for icons.
Utilize generous spacing; cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
